accounting.note: The accounting span includes compilation, validation and host work; it is not CUDA elapsed time.

independent_consistency_scope: Read-only source, arithmetic, raw-sample, clean-snapshot and terminal-accounting consistency; no new GPU reproduction.
limits: Fixed random weights and inputs; architecture computation only, no pretrained text-model inference or quality measurement.
The compiled PyTorch baseline is faster than the candidate block in all four measured cases.
Repeated fixed tensors can fit cache; CUDA-event full calls include dispatch gaps, and host latency is recorded separately.
Only the declared four shapes were GPU measured; this is not an exhaustive domain or workload evaluation.
Original operator source bytes, mathematical contracts and tolerances were preserved; this application result does not prove AGH-version performance causality.
